headline: Bush order updates earlier executive orders to reflect moving certain government duties to the new Secretary of Homeland Security.
what_it_does: This order changes the wording of earlier executive orders and related actions to match the creation of the Department of Homeland Security. Where older orders gave certain duties to other agencies or officials, this order shifts those duties to the Secretary of Homeland Security. The title does not list which specific orders or duties are affected.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies whose duties moved to Homeland Security
who_it_affects.how: Some responsibilities described in earlier executive orders are reassigned from these agencies to the Secretary of Homeland Security.
The Secretary of Homeland Security takes on duties previously assigned elsewhere under older executive orders.
